record.question: Endogenous filtration marker includes all except:
record.explanation: Official final key: C — C-peptide. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 11, printed Q34. Source limitation: The category “endogenous filtration marker” is undefined; C-peptide can be a renal filtration/clearance marker in research, though it is not a routine clinical eGFR marker. Define “routine clinical marker” if C-peptide is intended as the exception. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
